purpose: Close the currently accessible project/OEM integration-source search for a project-specific bottle-centering owner without inferring that no unpublished/private source exists, and define the boundary for transition into explicit mechanism engineering / proof-of-principle.

search_surfaces.scope: Fresh nested sw_query_components(top_level_only=false) on active v43 assembly; 64 components inspected with targeted name/path search for PRISM, roller, belt, carrier, slider, actuator, spring, cylinder, pneumatic, wrap, centering and guide terms.
search_surfaces.result: Relevant closure-like geometry is project FITCHECK geometry. No non-FITCHECK project/OEM component was identified as the bottle-centering closure owner. FITCHECK_PRISM_ACTUATOR_ENVELOPE remains an envelope, not an identified actuator.
search_surfaces.limitation: Component inventory and naming cannot prove that no mechanism exists in features, unpublished configurations, external assemblies, or unavailable integration sources.

search_surfaces.scope: Bounded searches for product centering, roller prism, centering prism, IXOR prism, Aesus, labeler prism and integration bottle centering.
search_surfaces.result: Accessible matches resolve primarily to CAB IXOR+/ROXI manuals/catalog material; no project-specific integrator drawing, BOM, or centering assembly source was found.
search_surfaces.limitation: Drive search is best-effort retrieval, not proof that no unindexed, inaccessible, differently named, or external document exists.

search_surfaces.scope: Current PLAN-0010 source review, function-first frontier, v43 Prism functional-temporal reference and reconciliation history.
search_surfaces.result: Project state consistently preserves CAPTURE_KINEMATIC_OWNER as unresolved; v43 Prism is candidate/FITCHECK geometry and comparative publisher references do not bind ownership.
search_surfaces.limitation: GitHub contains versioned project knowledge only; absence of an external source from the repository is not evidence that such a source does not exist.

search_surfaces.scope: Current IXOR+ 04/2026 assembly instructions plus current IXOR+ public product/accessory/download surfaces.
search_surfaces.result: IXOR+ documentation exposes PRISM as input pin 2 for starting product centering, with roller prism as an example. The public IXOR+ accessory surface documents demand units, carriages, wipe-down rollers/brushes, mounting rods, sensors and stands but does not identify a roller-prism product-handling mechanism or its actuator/mounting.
search_surfaces.limitation: Public CAB documentation does not establish the complete universe of customer-specific or partner integration hardware.

authoritative_source_findings.bounded_claim: The START interface separates PRISM IN 'Start product centering (e.g. roller prism)' from START IN 'Start labeling'.
The current public IXOR+ product/accessory page describes the labeling head and listed accessories but does not identify a roller-prism product-handling mechanism.
does_not_establish: that CAB never supplies or integrates a roller prism
that no private/customer-specific centering assembly exists

comparative_pattern_references.bounded_paraphrase: HERMA describes a roller-prism station in which the product is positioned by a stop, rotated by a rotation unit, and labeled by a pivoting peel edge/pressure roller; a separate HERMA 500 base unit drives the roller prism.
comparative_pattern_references.relevance: Shows that a roller prism can be a distinct driven product-handling subsystem rather than a passive property of the label dispenser.

comparative_pattern_references.bounded_paraphrase: HERMA describes its roller prism as rotating and fixing the product during labeling.
comparative_pattern_references.relevance: Supports the functional class of a combined restraint/rotation subsystem.

comparative_pattern_references.bounded_paraphrase: Aesus describes twin adjustable rollers pressing a container against a wrap belt for alignment/support.
comparative_pattern_references.relevance: Supports a common roller-plus-wrap-belt capture architecture class.

exhaustion_conclusion.interpretation: No accessible authoritative source currently binds the project-specific physical centering owner. This does not convert the unknown into a negative fact and does not reject any candidate family.
reopen_conditions: project BOM or assembly documentation tied to the actual machine
CAB/partner response naming the product-centering assembly
other authoritative source with exact owner/mounting/kinematic binding

transition_authorization_scope: Project-state planning only. No SOLIDWORKS geometry creation, movement, mating, save, or other CAD mutation is authorized.
